items.topic: What is the 'No Effort' idea about?
items.context: The item has no description. The name 'No Effort' suggests reducing effort for some task or workflow, but we need to understand the core concept before anything else can proceed. Please describe what you envision.

options.label: Low-effort scenario creation
options.rationale: A way to create new Vrooli scenarios with minimal manual setup — e.g., a single prompt or template that scaffolds everything

options.label: Effort-reduction tooling for existing workflows
options.rationale: Tools or automation that reduce repetitive effort in existing Vrooli development workflows (testing, deployment, etc.)

options.label: A product/service idea named 'No Effort'
options.rationale: A standalone product or SaaS scenario targeting end-users, where the brand/value prop is 'zero effort' for the user

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe your own vision in the freeform field

items.context: Who benefits from this idea? The answer shapes scope, UI needs, and deployment model.

options.label: Vrooli developers / internal team
options.rationale: Internal tooling that makes building scenarios faster or easier

options.label: End-users / customers
options.rationale: A user-facing product or service that external people interact with

options.label: Both internal and external
options.rationale: Internal capability that also has external value as a product

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe in freeform

items.topic: Should this be a new scenario or an enhancement to an existing one?
items.context: Vrooli has many existing scenarios. This idea might fit as an improvement to an existing scenario rather than requiring a new one.

options.label: New standalone scenario
options.rationale: The idea is distinct enough to warrant its own scenario with its own API/UI/CLI

options.label: Enhancement to an existing scenario
options.rationale: The idea fits naturally as a feature addition to an existing scenario (specify which one in freeform)

options.label: Cross-cutting improvement
options.rationale: Changes to shared infrastructure, CLI, or tooling that benefits multiple scenarios

options.label: Not sure yet
options.rationale: Need to define the idea further before deciding

items.topic: What resources or scenarios does this depend on?
items.context: Understanding dependencies helps scope the work and identify integration points. Select the closest match or describe in freeform.

options.label: Minimal — just standard Vrooli infra (postgres, redis)
options.rationale: Lightweight idea with few external dependencies

options.label: AI/ML resources (ollama, claude-code, etc.)
options.rationale: The idea involves AI-powered automation or intelligence

options.label: Multiple existing scenarios
options.rationale: Orchestrates or composes capabilities from other scenarios

options.label: Unknown / needs research
options.rationale: Dependencies aren't clear yet

items.context: The item is set to priority 5 (middle of the range). Understanding urgency helps determine how much upfront planning vs. quick prototyping is appropriate.

options.label: Quick prototype / spike first
options.rationale: Build something small to validate the concept before investing in full planning

options.label: Full planning then execution
options.rationale: Invest in a thorough plan, workshop rounds, and research before building

options.label: Low priority / parking lot
options.rationale: Capture the idea for future consideration but don't invest heavily now

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe your preferred approach
